template.title: Entanglement-assisted quantum code [[{n},{k};{c}]] over GF({q})
template.statement: Find an entanglement-assisted quantum code of length {n} with local dimension {q} that encodes {k} qudits with the help of {c} maximally entangled pairs and whose minimum distance is as large as possible. It is given by an additive group S of {q}^({n}-{k}+{c}) elements of GF({q})^(2 x {n}) on which the trace-symplectic form has rank 2 x {c}; the distance is the least symplectic weight of an element of the trace-symplectic dual S' of S that is not in S (for k = 0: of a nonzero element of S', or n + 1 when S' = 0), as in Luo, Ezerman, Grassl and Ling, arXiv:2207.05647.
template.submission: Text file: the generators of S, one per line, 2 x {n} elements of GF({q}) (the X part, then the Z part; a '|' between them is allowed) written as integers below {q}; see checkers/qcode_check.py.

best_text: The best known lower bound in the table is {best} ({holder}); a code with a larger minimum distance improves it.
bound_source: the upper bound in the same table
holder_unknown: the table names the construction of each entry
holder_sources: the construction named in the entry's cell of the table (a propagation rule from another entry, a known family, or a source)
open_rule: every entry with c >= 1 whose lower bound is below its upper bound
work_rule: kept when the check lists at most 2^34 elements of S (qubits, n - k + c <= 34) or 2^31 lines through the origin (qutrits, n - k + c <= 20)
